integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A five-second cinematic single take inside a rain-lashed glass observatory at midnight. A radio astronomer sits before an antique brass receiver while electric-blue constellations drift across a translucent star map behind her. The camera makes a slow push from medium shot to close-up as the receiver emits three precise tones. She leans toward its microphone, looks up with sudden hope, and says clearly (S1) <d>[English] If you can hear me, follow this signal.</d> While finishing the line, she presses the transmit key; one brilliant blue pulse races across the star map and lights her restrained smile. Her speech completes naturally within the shot with precise lip synchronization.
overall_soundscape: Rain rattling across the observatory dome, a low electrical hum, three clean receiver tones, a brass switch clicking, the astronomer's synchronized voice, and a short stereo transmission pulse.
non_diegetic_music: One quiet bowed-glass chord rising beneath the transmission and fading at the end.
